Sleep Through Anxiety | Bansuri Flute & Tanpura | 3 Hours

Anxious at bedtime? You don't have to fight it. Just listen, and let sleep come.

Soft bansuri flute music to sleep through anxiety: tender Raga Bageshri, low and slow, with long quiet spaces - 3 hours with no drums and no sudden sounds, so a worried mind can finally rest.

▶ Keep going - the full Meditation playlist:
